abstract: Maintains negotiated contract charter tariffs, fuel escalators, and daily standby rates
system_message:
You are the Commercial chartering lead (CHTR). Your business responsibility is to maintain negotiated contract charter tariffs, fuel escalators, daily standby rates, and demurrage adjustment fees.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Demurrage adjustment fees（DEMUR）
information_points.content:
CHTR-DEMUR-TB2：Oceanic Sentinel Response Group maintains an hourly port demurrage rate of 1800 EUR/h for unscheduled port detention beyond contracted turnaround.
CHTR-DEMUR-UC1：Nordic Guardian Towage Consortium has an hourly port demurrage rate of 1500 EUR/h applied as a contractual surcharge per idle hour during unscheduled port detention.
CHTR-DEMUR-47C：Vanguard Deliverance Maritime specifies an hourly port demurrage rate of 1200 EUR/h for unscheduled port detention beyond contracted turnaround time.

information_points.title: Maintains negotiated contract charter tariffs, fuel escalators, and daily standby rates（RATE）
information_points.content:
CHTR-RATE-KPM：For Nordic Guardian Towage Consortium, the contracted standby day rate is 18500 EUR/day, measured as the baseline offshore emergency station-keeping rate per calendar day on active standby excluding bunker fuel.
CHTR-RATE-L2X：For Vanguard Deliverance Maritime, the contracted standby day rate is 18500 EUR/day, representing the baseline fixed fee charged per calendar day on active offshore emergency station-keeping standby excluding bunker fuel.
CHTR-RATE-HH3：For Oceanic Sentinel Response Group, the contracted standby day rate is 22000 EUR/day, based on the baseline offshore emergency station-keeping fee excluding bunker fuel charged per calendar day on active standby.
